This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: **/*.cs, **/*.cshtml, **/*.csproj, **/*.sln, **/*.json, **/*.md, **/Dockerfile, **/.dockerignore
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/Properties/**, **/wwwroot/**, **/PositiveNews.WebApi/**, **/logs/**, **/bin/**, **/obj/**, **/.vs/**, **/.vscode/**, **/TestResults/**, **/*.user, **/*.suo, **/AppPackages/**, **/BundleArtifacts/**, **/dist/**, **/node_modules/**, **/Migrations/**, **/appsettings.Development.json, **/appsettings.Local.json, repomix-output.txt, repomix.config.json, **/*.sql, **/*.csproj
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 5: 
 6: /// <summary>
 7: /// EF surface used by ingestion queries/commands so handlers stay testable and persistence stays in Infrastructure.
 8: /// </summary>
 9: public interface IIngestionDbContext
10: {
11:     DbSet<Topic> Topics { get; }
12:     DbSet<Source> Sources { get; }
13:     DbSet<ArticleMetadata> ArticlesMetadata { get; }
14:     DbSet<ArticleContent> ArticlesContent { get; }
15:     DbSet<ArticleTopic> ArticleTopics { get; }
16:     DbSet<IngestionRun> IngestionRuns { get; }
17: 
18:     Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
19: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler.cs
================
  1: using MediatR;
  2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
  5: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
  6: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  7: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
  8: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  9: 
 10: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
 11: 
 12: public sealed class PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler(
 13:     IIngestionDbContext db,
 14:     ILogger<PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler> logger)
 15:     : IRequestHandler<PersistIngestedArticlesCommand, int>
 16: {
 17:     public async Task<int> Handle(PersistIngestedArticlesCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 18:     {
 19:         if (request.Items.Count == 0)
 20:             return 0;
 21: 
 22:         var totalSaved = 0;
 23:         var chunkSize = IngestionPipelineConstants.ArticlePersistChunkSize;
 24: 
 25:         for (var i = 0; i < request.Items.Count; i += chunkSize)
 26:         {
 27:             var chunk = request.Items.Skip(i).Take(chunkSize).ToList();
 28:             var pairs = new List<(ArticleMetadata Meta, RssFeedItemDto Dto)>();
 29: 
 30:             foreach (var dto in chunk)
 31:             {
 32:                 try
 33:                 {
 34:                     var meta = CreateArticleMetadata(request.SourceId, request.DefaultLanguageCode, dto);
 35:                     pairs.Add((meta, dto));
 36:                     db.ArticlesMetadata.Add(meta);
 37:                 }
 38:                 catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 39:                 {
 40:                     logger.LogError(ex, "Error building article entity for external id: {ExternalId}", dto.ExternalId);
 41:                 }
 42:             }
 43: 
 44:             if (pairs.Count == 0)
 45:                 continue;
 46: 
 47:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 48:             await AppendArticleTopicsAsync(pairs, cancellationToken);
 49:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 50: 
 51:             foreach (var (_, dto) in pairs)
 52:                 logger.LogInformation("Ingested new article: {Title}", dto.Title);
 53: 
 54:             totalSaved += pairs.Count;
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         return totalSaved;
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     private static ArticleMetadata CreateArticleMetadata(int sourceId, string defaultLanguageCode, RssFeedItemDto dto)
 61:     {
 62:         var articleMeta = new ArticleMetadata
 63:         {
 64:             SourceId = sourceId,
 65:             ExternalId = dto.ExternalId,
 66:             Title = dto.Title,
 67:             Author = dto.Author,
 68:             Url = dto.Link,
 69:             ImageTag = dto.ImageTag,
 70:             PublishedAt = dto.PublishedDate,
 71:             IngestedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
 72:             LanguageCode = defaultLanguageCode,
 73:             RegionCode = "Global",
 74:             IsActive = true,
 75:             SummaryShort = dto.Description,
 76:             PositivityScore = dto.PositivityScore,
 77:             AnalyzedAt = dto.PositivityScore.HasValue ? DateTime.UtcNow : null
 78:         };
 79: 
 80:         articleMeta.Content = new ArticleContent
 81:         {
 82:             ContentRaw = dto.ContentRaw,
 83:             ContentClean = dto.ContentClean
 84:         };
 85: 
 86:         return articleMeta;
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     private async Task AppendArticleTopicsAsync(
 90:         IReadOnlyList<(ArticleMetadata Meta, RssFeedItemDto Dto)> pairs,
 91:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 92:     {
 93:         var names = pairs
 94:             .SelectMany(p => p.Dto.Topics ?? Enumerable.Empty<string>())
 95:             .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 96:             .ToList();
 97: 
 98:         if (names.Count == 0)
 99:             return;
100: 
101:         var topicIdByName = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
102:         foreach (var nameChunk in names.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
103:         {
104:             var arr = nameChunk.ToArray();
105:             var rows = await db.Topics
106:                 .AsNoTracking()
107:                 .Where(t => arr.Contains(t.Name))
108:                 .Select(t => new { t.Id, t.Name })
109:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
110: 
111:             foreach (var row in rows)
112:                 topicIdByName[row.Name] = row.Id;
113:         }
114: 
115:         foreach (var (meta, dto) in pairs)
116:         {
117:             if (dto.Topics == null || dto.Topics.Count == 0)
118:                 continue;
119: 
120:             var seenTopicIds = new HashSet<int>();
121:             foreach (var topicName in dto.Topics)
122:             {
123:                 if (!topicIdByName.TryGetValue(topicName, out var topicId) || !seenTopicIds.Add(topicId))
124:                     continue;
125: 
126:                 db.ArticleTopics.Add(new ArticleTopic
127:                 {
128:                     ArticleId = meta.Id,
129:                     TopicId = topicId
130:                 });
131:             }
132:         }
133:     }
134: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler.cs
================
  1: using MediatR;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
  5: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  6: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  7: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
  8: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  9: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 10: 
 11: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
 12: 
 13: public sealed class ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler(
 14:     IIngestionDbContext db,
 15:     IFeedReader feedReader,
 16:     IFeedProcessor feedProcessor,
 17:     IMediator mediator,
 18:     ILogger<ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler> logger)
 19:     : IRequestHandler<ProcessIngestionSourceCommand>
 20: {
 21:     public async Task Handle(ProcessIngestionSourceCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 22:     {
 23:         var source = request.Source;
 24:         logger.LogInformation("Processing source: {SourceName} ({FeedUrl})", source.Name, source.FeedUrl);
 25: 
 26:         var run = new IngestionRun
 27:         {
 28:             SourceId = source.Id,
 29:             StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
 30:             Status = IngestionStatus.Running
 31:         };
 32:         db.IngestionRuns.Add(run);
 33:         await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 34: 
 35:         var newArticleCount = 0;
 36:         var url = source.FeedUrl;
 37: 
 38:         try
 39:         {
 40:             var doc = await feedReader.ReadFeedAsync(url, cancellationToken);
 41:             var processingResult = feedProcessor.ProcessFeed(url, doc, request.TopicLookup, cancellationToken);
 42:             var dtoItems = processingResult.Items;
 43:             var invalidCount = processingResult.InvalidCount;
 44: 
 45:             var skipCount = invalidCount;
 46: 
 47:             if (dtoItems.Count == 0)
 48:             {
 49:                 logger.LogWarning("Source {SourceName} returned zero feed items.", source.Name);
 50:                 run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
 51:                 run.ErrorMessage = "Feed returned zero items. The feed URL may be unavailable or empty.";
 52:                 run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
 53:                 await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 54:                 return;
 55:             }
 56: 
 57:             var existingKeys = await mediator.Send(
 58:                 new FindExistingArticleKeysQuery(
 59:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.ExternalId).ToList(),
 60:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.Link).ToList(),
 61:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.Title).ToList()),
 62:                 cancellationToken);
 63: 
 64:             var toPersist = new List<RssFeedItemDto>();
 65:             var pendingExternalIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 66:             var pendingUrls = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 67:             var pendingTitles = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 68: 
 69:             foreach (var item in dtoItems)
 70:             {
 71:                 cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
 72: 
 73:                 if (existingKeys.Matches(item))
 74:                 {
 75:                     logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate: {Title}", item.Title);
 76:                     skipCount++;
 77:                     continue;
 78:                 }
 79: 
 80:                 if (ConflictsWithPendingBatch(item, pendingExternalIds, pendingUrls, pendingTitles))
 81:                 {
 82:                     logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate within feed: {Title}", item.Title);
 83:                     skipCount++;
 84:                     continue;
 85:                 }
 86: 
 87:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ExternalId))
 88:                     pendingExternalIds.Add(item.ExternalId);
 89:                 pendingUrls.Add(item.Link);
 90:                 pendingTitles.Add(item.Title);
 91:                 toPersist.Add(item);
 92:             }
 93: 
 94:             newArticleCount = await mediator.Send(
 95:                 new PersistIngestedArticlesCommand(source.Id, source.DefaultLanguageCode, toPersist),
 96:                 cancellationToken);
 97: 
 98:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Success;
 99:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
100:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
101:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
102: 
103:             logger.LogInformation(
104:                 "Source {SourceName}: ingested {NewCount} new articles out of {TotalCount} feed items. {SkipCount} rejected.",
105:                 source.Name,
106:                 newArticleCount,
107:                 dtoItems.Count + invalidCount,
108:                 skipCount);
109:         }
110:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
111:         {
112:             logger.LogWarning("Ingestion for {SourceName} was cancelled.", source.Name);
113:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
114:             run.ErrorMessage = "Operation was cancelled.";
115:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
116:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
117:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
118:         }
119:         catch (Exception ex)
120:         {
121:             logger.LogError(ex, "Error ingesting source {SourceName}.", source.Name);
122:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Failed;
123:             run.ErrorMessage = ex.Message.Length > 4000 ? ex.Message[..4000] : ex.Message;
124:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
125:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
126:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
127:         }
128:     }
129: 
130:     private static bool ConflictsWithPendingBatch(
131:         RssFeedItemDto item,
132:         HashSet<string> pendingExternalIds,
133:         HashSet<string> pendingUrls,
134:         HashSet<string> pendingTitles)
135:     {
136:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ExternalId) && pendingExternalIds.Contains(item.ExternalId))
137:             return true;
138:         if (pendingUrls.Contains(item.Link))
139:             return true;
140:         return pendingTitles.Contains(item.Title);
141:     }
142: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 7: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
10: 
11: public sealed class RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RunIngestionCycleCommand>
12: {
13:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
14:     private readonly ILogger<RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler> _logger;
15: 
16:     public RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler(
17:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
18:         ILogger<RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler> logger)
19:     {
20:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
21:         _logger = logger;
22:     }
23: 
24:     public async Task Handle(RunIngestionCycleCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
25:     {
26:         _logger.LogInformation("---=== Ingestion cycle started. ===---");
27: 
28:         TopicLookup topicLookup;
29:         IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot> activeSources;
30: 
31:         // This scope fetches the topics and active sources. Once it fetches them, it closes.
32:         // This ensures the database connection used for this quick read is released immediately
33:         using (var initialScope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope())
34:         {
35:             var mediator = initialScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
36:             topicLookup = await mediator.Send(new GetTopicLookupQuery(), cancellationToken);
37:             _logger.LogInformation("Topic lookup built with {Count} topics.", topicLookup.ByName.Count);
38:             activeSources = await mediator.Send(new GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery(), cancellationToken);
39:         }
40: 
41:         _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} active sources with feed URLs.", activeSources.Count);
42: 
43:         foreach (var source in activeSources)
44:         {
45:             if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
46:                 break;
47: 
48:             // Get a brand - new, clean database connection for each news site.
49:             // If one fails, the others may succeed, and memory is cleared after each loop.
50:             using var sourceScope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
51:             var mediator = sourceScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
52:             await mediator.Send(new ProcessIngestionSourceCommand(source, topicLookup), cancellationToken);
53: 
54:             if (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
55:             {
56:                 _logger.LogDebug("Cancellation requested. Waiting {Delay} before next source...", 
57:                     IngestionPipelineConstants.DelayBetweenSources);
58:                 await Task.Delay(IngestionPipelineConstants.DelayBetweenSources, cancellationToken);
59:             }
60:         }
61: 
62:         _logger.LogInformation("=== Ingestion cycle completed. ===");
63:     }
64: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Application/DTOs/ExistingArticleKeys.cs
================
 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 2: 
 3: /// <summary>
 4: /// Keys already present in storage, used to skip duplicates without per-item queries.
 5: /// </summary>
 6: public sealed class ExistingArticleKeys
 7: {
 8:     public HashSet<string> ExternalIds { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 9:     public HashSet<string> Urls { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
10:     public HashSet<string> Titles { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
11: 
12:     public bool Matches(RssFeedItemDto dto) =>
13:         (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dto.ExternalId) && ExternalIds.Contains(dto.ExternalId))
14:         || Urls.Contains(dto.Link)
15:         || Titles.Contains(dto.Title);
16: }

2:

4: /// Immutable view of a source row needed for one ingestion pass (no EF tracking).
5: /// </summary>

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/Ingestion/IngestionPipelineConstants.cs
================
 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 2: 
 3: public static class IngestionPipelineConstants
 4: {
 5:     public static readonly TimeSpan DelayBetweenSources = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);
 6: 
 7:     /// <summary>Articles inserted per SaveChanges batch (metadata + content, then topics).</summary>
 8:     public const int ArticlePersistChunkSize = 25;
 9: 
10:     /// <summary>SQL Server parameter budget — split IN clauses when lists are large.</summary>
11:     public const int SqlInClauseChunkSize = 500;
12: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Ingestion/FindExistingArticleKeysQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 7: 
 8: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Ingestion;
 9: 
10: public sealed class FindExistingArticleKeysQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
11:     : IRequestHandler<FindExistingArticleKeysQuery, ExistingArticleKeys>
12: {
13:     public async Task<ExistingArticleKeys> Handle(
14:         FindExistingArticleKeysQuery request,
15:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
16:     {
17:         var result = new ExistingArticleKeys();
18: 
19:         var extDistinct = request.ExternalIds
20:             .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x))
21:             .Distinct()
22:             .ToList();
23: 
24:         foreach (var chunk in extDistinct.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
25:         {
26:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
27:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
28:                 .Where(a => a.ExternalId != null && chunkArr.Contains(a.ExternalId))
29:                 .Select(a => a.ExternalId!)
30:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
31:             foreach (var id in batch)
32:                 result.ExternalIds.Add(id);
33:         }
34: 
35:         var urls = request.Urls.Distinct().ToList();
36:         foreach (var chunk in urls.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
37:         {
38:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
39:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
40:                 .Where(a => chunkArr.Contains(a.Url))
41:                 .Select(a => a.Url)
42:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
43:             foreach (var u in batch)
44:                 result.Urls.Add(u);
45:         }
46: 
47:         var titles = request.Titles.Distinct().ToList();
48:         foreach (var chunk in titles.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
49:         {
50:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
51:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
52:                 .Where(a => chunkArr.Contains(a.Title))
53:                 .Select(a => a.Title)
54:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
55:             foreach (var t in batch)
56:                 result.Titles.Add(t);
57:         }
58: 
59:         return result;
60:     }
61: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Ingestion/GetActiveIngestionSourcesQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Ingestion;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class GetActiveIngestionSourcesQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
10:     : IRequestHandler<GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery, IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot>>
11: {
12:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot>> Handle(
13:         GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery request,
14:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
15:     {
16:         return await db.Sources
17:             .AsNoTracking()
18:             .Where(s => s.IsActive && s.FeedUrl != null)
19:             .OrderBy(s => s.Id)
20:             .Select(s => new IngestionSourceSnapshot(s.Id, s.Name, s.FeedUrl!, s.DefaultLanguageCode))
21:             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
22:     }
23: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Ingestion/GetTopicLookupQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Ingestion;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class GetTopicLookupQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
10:     : IRequestHandler<GetTopicLookupQuery, TopicLookup>
11: {
12:     public async Task<TopicLookup> Handle(GetTopicLookupQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
13:     {

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleTopicConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleTopicConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleTopic>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleTopic> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticleTopics", SchemaNames.Catalog);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(at => new { at.ArticleId, at.TopicId });
15: 
16:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Article)
17:                .WithMany(a => a.ArticleTopics)
18:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.ArticleId)
19:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
20: 
21:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Topic)
22:                .WithMany(t => t.ArticleTopics)
23:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.TopicId)
24:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
25: 
26:         // Reverse lookup index
27:         builder.HasIndex(at => at.TopicId)
28:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticleTopics_Topic_Lookup");
29:     }
30: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/AuditLogConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 8: 
 9: public class AuditLogConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<AuditLog>
10: {
11:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<AuditLog> builder)
12:     {
13:         builder.ToTable("AuditLogs", SchemaNames.Admin);
14: 
15:         builder.HasKey(al => al.Id);
16: 
17:         builder.Property(al => al.EntityType)
18:                .HasMaxLength(50)
19:                .HasConversion<string>();
20: 
21:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
22:             "CK_Audit_Entity", "[EntityType] IN ('Article', 'Comment', 'User', 'Source')"));
23: 
24:         builder.Property(al => al.ChangedField).HasMaxLength(100);
25:         builder.Property(al => al.OldValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
26:         builder.Property(al => al.NewValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
27:         builder.Property(al => al.Reason).HasMaxLength(500);
28:         builder.Property(al => al.Note).HasMaxLength(1000);
29:         builder.Property(al => al.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
30: 
31:         builder.HasOne(al => al.Moderator)
32:                .WithMany()
33:                .HasForeignKey(al => al.ModeratorId)
34:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
35: 
36:         // History lookup index
37:         builder.HasIndex(al => new { al.EntityType, al.EntityId, al.CreatedAt })
38:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
39:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_AuditLogs_Entity_History");
40:     }
41: }

 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;

 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;

 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;

 9: public class IngestionRunConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<IngestionRun>

12:     {
13:         builder.ToTable("IngestionRuns", SchemaNames.Catalog);
14: 
15:         builder.HasKey(ir => ir.Id);
16: 
17:         // Store enum as string for readability and to match the SQL CHECK constraint.
18:         builder.Property(ir => ir.Status)
19:                .HasMaxLength(50)
20:                .HasConversion<string>();

26:         builder.Property(ir => ir.ErrorMessage).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
27: 
28:         builder.HasOne(ir => ir.Source)
29:                .WithMany(s => s.IngestionRuns)
30:                .HasForeignKey(ir => ir.SourceId)
31:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
32:     }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/RoleConfiguration.cs

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/SourceConfiguration.cs

 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class SourceConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Source>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Source> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("Sources", SchemaNames.Catalog);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(s => s.Id);
15:         builder.Property(s => s.Name).HasMaxLength(200).IsRequired();
16:         builder.Property(s => s.Description).HasMaxLength(1000);
17:         builder.Property(s => s.BaseUrl).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired();
18:         builder.Property(s => s.FeedUrl).HasMaxLength(500);
19:         builder.Property(s => s.LogoUrl).HasMaxLength(500);
20:         builder.Property(s => s.ApiEndpoint).HasMaxLength(500);
21:         builder.Property(s => s.ApiEncryptedKey).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
22:         builder.Property(s => s.TrustScore).HasColumnType("decimal(5,2)").HasDefaultValue(1.0m);
23: 
24:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint("CK_Sources_Trust", "[TrustScore] >= 0.00"));
25: 
26:         builder.Property(s => s.DefaultLanguageCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("en");
27:         builder.Property(s => s.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
28:         builder.Property(s => s.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
29: 
30:         builder.HasOne(s => s.Moderator)
31:                .WithMany()
32:                .HasForeignKey(s => s.ModeratedBy)
33:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
34:     }
35: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedReader.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 4: using System.Xml.Linq;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 7: 
 8: public class FeedReader : IFeedReader
 9: {
10:     private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory; // registered in Infrastructure.DependencyInjection (services.AddHttpClient())
11:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
12: 
13:     public FeedReader(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<FeedReader> logger)
14:     {
15:         _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
16:         _logger = logger;
17:     }
18: 
19:     async Task<XDocument> IFeedReader.ReadFeedAsync(string feedUrl, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
20:     {
21:         _logger.LogInformation("Fetching RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
22: 
23:         var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("RssFeedClient");
24:         using var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(feedUrl, cancellationToken);
25:         response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
26: 
27:         using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken);
28:         return XDocument.Load(stream);
29:     }
30: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer.cs
================
 1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 5: 
 6: public class KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer : IPositivityAnalyzer
 7: {
 8:     private static readonly HashSet<string> PositiveWords = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 9:     {
10:         "good", "great", "excellent", "positive", "happy", "success", "breakthrough",
11:         "innovative", "uplifting", "joy", "wonderful", "win", "progress", "inspiring",
12:         "cure", "hero", "solution", "miracle", "triumph", "beautiful", "love"
13:     };
14: 
15:     private static readonly HashSet<string> NegativeWords = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
16:     {
17:         "bad", "terrible", "awful", "negative", "sad", "fail", "failure", "crisis",
18:         "disaster", "tragedy", "loss", "pain", "death", "murder", "war", "crash",
19:         "devastating", "horrible", "fear", "hate", "violence"
20:     };
21: 
22:     public decimal AnalyzeSentiment(string? htmlContent)
23:     {
24:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(htmlContent))
25:             return 0.5000m; // Neutral default
26: 
27:         // 1. Strip HTML tags to analyze purely text
28:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
29:         doc.LoadHtml(htmlContent);
30:         var plainText = doc.DocumentNode.InnerText; 
31: 
32:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(plainText))
33:             return 0.5000m;
34: 
35:         // 2. Split text into distinct words
36:         var words = plainText.Split(new[] { ' ', '.', ',', ';', '!', '?', '\n', '\r', '"', '\'' },
37:                                StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
38: 
39:         int posCount = 0;
40:         int negCount = 0;
41: 
42:         foreach (var word in words)
43:         {
44:             if (PositiveWords.Contains(word)) posCount++;
45:             if (NegativeWords.Contains(word)) negCount++;
46:         }
47: 
48:         int totalScored = posCount + negCount;
49: 
50:         if (totalScored == 0)
51:             return 0.5000m; // Neutral if no keywords matched
52: 
53:         // 3. Calculate score between 0.0000 and 1.0000
54:         decimal score = (decimal)posCount / totalScored;
55: 
56:         return Math.Round(score, 3);
57:     }
58: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Web/Program.cs
================
 1: using Serilog;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application;
 3: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure;
 4: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seeding;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Web;
 7: 
 8: public class Program
 9: {
10:     public static async Task Main(string[] args)
11:     {
12:         // 1. Bootstrap Serilog for startup logging
13:         Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
14:             .WriteTo.Console()
15:             .WriteTo.File(
16:                 path: "logs/positivenews-.log",
17:                 rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
18:                 retainedFileCountLimit: 30,
19:                 outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} [{Level:u3}] {SourceContext}: {Message:lj}{NewLine}{Exception}")
20:             .CreateBootstrapLogger();
21: 
22:         try
23:         {
24:             Log.Information("Starting PositiveNews Web MVC...");
25: 
26:             var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
27: 
28:             // 2. Configure Serilog for the Host
29:             builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, loggerConfig) =>
30:             {
31:                 loggerConfig
32:                     .ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration)
33:                     .Enrich.FromLogContext()
34:                     .WriteTo.Console()
35:                     .WriteTo.File(
36:                         path: "logs/positivenews-.log",
37:                         rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
38:                         retainedFileCountLimit: 30,
39:                         outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} [{Level:u3}] {SourceContext}: {Message:lj}{NewLine}{Exception}");
40:             });
41: 
42:             // 3. Register Clean Architecture Layers & MVC
43:             builder.Services.AddApplicationServices();
44:             builder.Services.AddInfrastructureServices(builder.Configuration);
45:             builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews();
46: 
47:             var app = builder.Build();
48: 
49:             // 4. Seed Database (Applies migrations and populates sources/topics)
50:             await DataSeeder.SeedAsync(app.Services);
51: 
52:             // 5. Configure the HTTP request pipeline
53:             if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
54:             {
55:                 app.UseExceptionHandler("/Home/Error");
56:                 app.UseHsts();
57:             }
58: 
59:             app.UseSerilogRequestLogging();
60:             app.UseHttpsRedirection();
61:             app.UseStaticFiles(); // Required for MVC wwwroot assets
62:             app.UseRouting();
63:             app.UseAuthorization();
64: 
65:             app.MapControllerRoute(
66:                 name: "default",
67:                 pattern: "{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}");
68: 
69:             // 6. Run the application
70:             await app.RunAsync();
71:         }
72:         catch (Exception ex)
73:         {
74:             Log.Fatal(ex, "Application terminated unexpectedly.");
75:         }
76:         finally
77:         {
78:             await Log.CloseAndFlushAsync();
79:         }
80:     }
81: }

================
File: README.md
================
 1: Project Title: "PositiveNews".
 2: 
 3: Level: Educational.
 4: Status: Development.
 5: 
 6: Description: 
 7: A web platform combats "doom-scrolling" by aggregating news from various sources, 
 8: store them, and ranking them based on calculated score. Provides UI for viewing news sorted 
 9: by positivity
10: 
11: The "PositiveNews" features List:
12: 1. Ingestion Engine: Receiving news from various sources.
13: 2. Content Distiller: Get the core news text and short 1min-read summary.
14: 3. Secure Storage: Storing articles, summaries, and metadata in a structured database.
15: 4. Sentiment Assessor: Scoring articles for "positivity" (0.0 to 1.0).
16: 5. Configurable Feed: Public visibility of with a global "positivity" threshold.
17: 6. User Personalization: Authorized users can set their own positivity metrics.
18: 7. Adaptive Reader: Toggle between "Summary" and "Full Article" views.
19: 8. Community Interaction: Leaving and viewing comments on articles.
20: 9. Admin Command Center: Operations for article, sources list editing and comment moderation.
21: 10. Source Filtering: Narrowing the feed to specific trusted publishers (e.g., "Only Reuters").
22: 11. Topic Filtering: Categorizing news by domain (e.g., "Technology," "Health").
23: 12. Topics Sorting: By publication date, or "positivity" score.
24: 13. Automatic logging: Logging of operations with writing to stored text files.

File: src/PositiveNews.Application/DependencyInjection.cs
================
 1: using System.Reflection;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Application;
 5: 
 6: /// <summary>
 7: /// Clean Registration Pattern for the Application layer.
 8: /// </summary>
 9: public static class DependencyInjection
10: {
11:     public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services)
12:     {
13:         services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
14:             cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly()));
15: 
16:         return services;
17:     }
18: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Application/DTOs/TopicLookup.cs
================
 1: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 2: 
 3: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 4: 
 5: public class TopicLookup
 6: {
 7:     public Dictionary<string, Topic> ByName { get; set; } = [];
 8:     public Dictionary<string, List<Topic>> BySlugWord { get; set; } = [];
 9:     public Dictionary<string, List<Topic>> ChildToParentTopics { get; set; } = [];
10: 
11:     public static TopicLookup Build(IReadOnlyList<Topic> topics)
12:     {
13:         var lookup = new TopicLookup();
14: 
15:         foreach (var topic in topics)
16:         {
17:             lookup.ByName[topic.Name] = topic;
18: 
19:             var slugWords = topic.Slug?
20:                 .Split([',', ';', ' ', '|'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
21:                 .Select(w => w.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()) ?? [];
22: 
23:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
24:             {
25:                 if (!lookup.BySlugWord.ContainsKey(word))
26:                     lookup.BySlugWord[word] = [];
27:                 lookup.BySlugWord[word].Add(topic);
28:             }
29: 
30:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
31:             {
32:                 if (!lookup.ChildToParentTopics.ContainsKey(word))
33:                     lookup.ChildToParentTopics[word] = [];
34:                 lookup.ChildToParentTopics[word].Add(topic);
35:             }
36:         }
37: 
38:         return lookup;
39:     }
40: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Application/Interfaces/IFeedItemValidator.cs
================
1: using System.Xml.Linq;
2: 
3: public interface IFeedItemValidator

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Connection/ConnectionStringResolver.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: 
 4: public static class ConnectionStringResolver
 5: {
 6:     public static string Resolve(IConfiguration configuration)
 7:     {
 8:         var defaultConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
 9:         var altConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("AlternativeConnection");
10: 
11:         if (CanConnectToServer(defaultConn))
12:             return defaultConn!;
13: 
14:         if (CanConnectToServer(altConn))
15:             return altConn!;
16: 
17:         throw new InvalidOperationException(
18:             "Unable to connect to either DefaultConnection or AlternativeConnection.");
19:     }
20: 
21:     private static bool CanConnectToServer(string? connectionString)
22:     {
23:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
24:             return false;
25: 
26:         try
27:         {
28:             var builder = new SqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString)
29:             {
30:                 InitialCatalog = "master"
31:             };
32: 
33:             using var connection = new SqlConnection(builder.ConnectionString);
34:             connection.Open();
35:             return true;
36:         }
37:         catch
38:         {
39:             return false;
40:         }
41:     }
42: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleMetadataConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleMetadataConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleMetadata>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleMetadata> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticlesMetadata", SchemaNames.Catalog); 
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(a => a.Id);
15:         builder.Property(a => a.ExternalId).HasMaxLength(300);
16:         builder.Property(a => a.Title).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired();
17:         builder.Property(a => a.Author).HasMaxLength(300);
18:         builder.Property(a => a.Url).HasMaxLength(1000).IsRequired();
19:         builder.Property(a => a.ImageTag).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
20:         builder.Property(a => a.PublishedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
21:         builder.Property(a => a.IngestedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
22:         builder.Property(a => a.PositivityScore).HasColumnType("decimal(5,4)");
23:         builder.Property(a => a.ViewCount).HasDefaultValue(0L);
24:         builder.Property(a => a.LanguageCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("und");
25:         builder.Property(a => a.RegionCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("Global");
26:         builder.Property(a => a.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
27:         builder.Property(a => a.SummaryShort).HasMaxLength(2000);
28: 
29:         // Check constraint
30:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
31:             "CK_Articles_Positivity", "[PositivityScore] BETWEEN 0.0000 AND 1.0000"));
32: 
33:         // Deduplication unique index
34:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.SourceId, a.ExternalId })
35:                .IsUnique()
36:                .HasFilter("[ExternalId] IS NOT NULL")
37:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Source_ExternalId");
38: 
39:         // Feed performance index
40:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.LanguageCode, a.RegionCode, a.PublishedAt })
41:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
42:                .HasFilter("[IsActive] = 1")
43:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Feed_Date");
44: 
45:         // Source lookup index
46:         builder.HasIndex(a => a.SourceId)
47:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_SourceId");
48: 
49:         // Relationships
50:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Source)
51:                .WithMany(s => s.Articles)
52:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.SourceId)
53:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
54: 
55:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Moderator)
56:                .WithMany()
57:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.ModeratedBy)
58:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
59: 
60:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Content)
61:                .WithOne(c => c.Metadata)
62:                .HasForeignKey<ArticleContent>(c => c.Id)
63:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
64:     }
65: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/IngestionBackgroundService.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
 7: using static Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbLoggerCategory.Database;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
10: 
11: /// <summary>
12: /// A long-running hosted service that periodically triggers the ingestion cycle.
13: /// Interval is configurable via "Ingestion:IntervalMinutes" in appsettings.json.
14: /// </summary>
15: public class IngestionBackgroundService : BackgroundService // ← Implements IHostedService
16: {
17:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
18:     private readonly ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> _logger;
19:     private readonly TimeSpan _interval;
20: 
21:     /// <summary>
22:     /// Initial delay before the first run so the application has time to fully start.
23:     /// </summary>
24:     private static readonly TimeSpan _initialDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);
25: 
26:     public IngestionBackgroundService(   // Host Creates instances of IngestionBackgroundService when starts
27:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, // This service added to ASP .NET IoC by default. Needed for creation scope in singleton
28:         ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> logger,
29:         IConfiguration configuration)
30:     {
31:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
32:         _logger = logger;
33: 
34:         // Can't inject MediatR in class constructor because they have different lifecycle
35: 
36:         // Read interval from appsettings.json
37:         var minutes = configuration.GetValue<int>("Ingestion:IntervalMinutes", 60);
38:         _interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(minutes);
39:     }
40: 
41:     // THIS METHOD IS CALLED AUTOMATICALLY BY ASP.NET CORE WHEN HOST STARTS
42:     // ASP.NET Core host calls ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken) for each service after app.RunAsync() in programm.cs
43:     // because of BackgroundService implement IHostedService
44:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
45:     {
46:         _logger.LogInformation(
47:             "Ingestion Background Service started. Interval: {Interval}. Initial delay: {Delay}.",
48:             _interval, _initialDelay);
49: 
50:         // Wait for the application to fully initialize before the first run.
51:         await Task.Delay(_initialDelay, stoppingToken);
52: 
53:         while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested) // Infinite loop until app stops
54:         {
55:             try
56:             {
57:                 // This wraps the entire ingestion cycle. It creates a safe boundary and trigger the main
58:                 // Command Handler without polluting the Singleton host.
59:                 using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
60:                 var mediator = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
61: 
62:                 await mediator.Send(new RunIngestionCycleCommand(), stoppingToken);
63:             }
64:             catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
65:             {
66:                 _logger.LogInformation("Ingestion Background Service is stopping.");
67:                 break; // ← Exit loop on shutdown
68:             }
69:             catch (Exception ex)
70:             {
71:                 _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception in ingestion cycle. Will retry after interval.");
72:             }
73: 
74:             // Wait for the configured interval before the next run.
75:             if (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
76:             {
77:                 _logger.LogInformation("Next ingestion cycle in {Interval}.", _interval);
78:                 await Task.Delay(_interval, stoppingToken);
79:             }
80:         }
81:     }
82: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/ImgTagExtractor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  6: using System;
  7: using System.Collections.Generic;
  8: using System.Net;
  9: using System.Text;
 10: using System.Xml.Linq;
 11: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Constants;
 12: 
 13: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 14: 
 15: public class ImgTagExtractor : IImgTagExtractor
 16: {
 17:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
 18: 
 19:     private static readonly XNamespace MediaNs = "http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/";
 20: 
 21:     public ImgTagExtractor(ILogger<FeedReader> logger)
 22:     {
 23:         _logger = logger;
 24:     }
 25:     public string? ExtractImgTag(XElement itemElement, string? contentClean, string feedUrl)
 26:     {
 27:         try
 28:         {
 29:             // 1. media:thumbnail (direct child or nested inside media:content)
 30:             var thumbnail =
 31:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail") ??
 32:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content")?.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail");
 33: 
 34:             if (thumbnail != null)
 35:             {
 36:                 return BuildImgTag(
 37:                     src: thumbnail.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 38:                     width: thumbnail.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 39:                     height: thumbnail.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 40:                     alt: thumbnail.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article thumbnail"
 41:                 );
 42:             }
 43: 
 44:             // 2. Prefered <img> inside <description>
 45:             var descriptionHtml = itemElement.Element("description")?.Value;
 46:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptionHtml))
 47:             {
 48:                 var imgFromDesc = ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(descriptionHtml);
 49:                 if (imgFromDesc != null)
 50:                     return imgFromDesc;
 51:             }
 52: 
 53:             // 3. Prefered <img> inside <contentClean> 
 54:             var imgFromEncoded = ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(contentClean);
 55:             if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 56:                 return imgFromEncoded;
 57: 
 58:             // 4. media:content (only reached if needed)
 59:             var mediaContent = itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content");
 60:             if (mediaContent != null)
 61:             {
 62:                 return BuildImgTag(
 63:                     src: mediaContent.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 64:                     width: mediaContent.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 65:                     height: mediaContent.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 66:                     alt: mediaContent.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article image"
 67:                 );
 68:             }
 69: 
 70:             // 5. Eny <img> inside <description>
 71:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptionHtml))
 72:             {
 73:                 var imgFromDesc = ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(descriptionHtml);
 74:                 if (imgFromDesc != null)
 75:                     return imgFromDesc;
 76:             }
 77: 
 78:             // 6. Eny <img> inside <contentClean> 
 79:             imgFromEncoded = ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(contentClean);
 80:             if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 81:                 return imgFromEncoded;
 82: 
 83:             _logger.LogDebug("No thumbnail image tag extracted for current article. Default will be assigned");
 84:             return AssignDefaultThumbnailImg(feedUrl);
 85:         }
 86:         catch (Exception ex)
 87:         {
 88:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error durring image tag extracting");
 89:             return null;
 90:         }
 91:     }
 92: 
 93: 
 94:     private static string? ExtractImgFromHtml(string? html, string xpathQuery)
 95:     {
 96:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
 97:             return null;
 98: 
 99:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
100:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
101: 
102:         var images = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes(xpathQuery);
103: 
104:         var img = images
105:             ?.OrderBy(node =>
106:             {
107:                 var heightAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("height", "");
108:                 var widthAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("width", "");
109: 
110:                 var height = int.TryParse(heightAttr, out var h) ? h : int.MaxValue;
111:                 var width = int.TryParse(widthAttr, out var w) ? w : int.MaxValue;
112: 
113:                 return height == int.MaxValue || width == int.MaxValue ? int.MaxValue : height / (double)width;
114:             })
115:             .FirstOrDefault();
116: 
117:         if (img == null)
118:             return null;
119: 
120:         return BuildImgTag(
121:             src: img.GetAttributeValue("src", ""),
122:             width: img.GetAttributeValue("width", ""),
123:             height: img.GetAttributeValue("height", ""),
124:             alt: img.GetAttributeValue("alt", "Article image"),
125:             srcset: img.GetAttributeValue("srcset", ""),
126:             sizes: img.GetAttributeValue("sizes", "")
127:         );
128:     }
129: 
130:     private static string? ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(string? html)
131:     => ExtractImgFromHtml(html, "//img[@srcset and not(@class=\"img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3\")]");
132: 
133:     private static string? ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(string? html)
134:         => ExtractImgFromHtml(html, "//img");
135: 
136:     private static string? CleanSrcsetForPreview(string? srcset)
137:     {
138:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
139:             return null;
140: 
141:         // Matches: URL + optional descriptor (e.g. "300w")
142:         var matches = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(
143:             srcset,
144:             @"(?<url>\S+)(?:\s+(?<w>\d+)w)?"
145:         );
146: 
147:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int? width)>();
148: 
149:         foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match match in matches)
150:         {
151:             var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
152:             int? width = null;
153: 
154:             if (match.Groups["w"].Success &&
155:                 int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
156:             {
157:                 width = w;
158:             }
159: 
160:             // Skip garbage matches
161:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url) || !url.StartsWith("http"))
162:                 continue;
163: 
164:             candidates.Add((url, width));
165:         }
166: 
167:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
168:             return null;
169: 
170:         var maxWidth = GetPreferredMaxWidth(candidates);
171: 
172:         var filtered = candidates
173:             .Where(c => !c.width.HasValue || c.width <= maxWidth)
174:             .OrderBy(c => c.width ?? int.MaxValue)
175:             .ToList();
176: 
177:         // Fallback: if nothing <= 1024, take smallest available
178:         if (filtered.Count == 0)
179:         {
180:             var smallest = candidates
181:                 .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
182:                 .OrderBy(c => c.width)
183:                 .FirstOrDefault();
184: 
185:             if (smallest.url != null)
186:                 filtered.Add(smallest);
187:         }
188: 
189:         return filtered.Count > 0
190:             ? string.Join(", ", filtered.Select(c =>
191:                 c.width.HasValue ? $"{c.url} {c.width}w" : c.url))
192:             : null;
193:     }
194: 
195:     private static string? BuildImgTag(
196:         string? src = "",
197:         string? width = "",
198:         string? height = "",
199:         string? alt = "",
200:         string? srcset = "",
201:         string? sizes = "")
202:     {
203:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(src))
204:             return null;
205: 
206:         alt ??= "Article image";
207: 
208:         // Clean and limit srcset
209:         srcset = CleanSrcsetForPreview(srcset);
210: 
211:         // Force safe sizes for card previews
212:         sizes = "(max-width: 576px) 100vw, (max-width: 992px) 80vw, 805px";
213: 
214:         var sb = new StringBuilder();
215: 
216:         var bestSrc = PickBestSrcFromSrcset(srcset) ?? src;
217: 
218:         sb.Append($"<img src=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(bestSrc)}\" ");
219: 
220:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(width))
221:         {
222:             sb.Append($"width=\"{width}\" ");
223:         }
224: 
225:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(height))
226:         {
227:             sb.Append($"height=\"{height}\" ");
228:         }
229: 
230:         sb.Append("class=\"img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3\" ");
231:         sb.Append($"alt=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(alt)}\" ");
232: 
233:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
234:         {
235:             sb.Append($"srcset=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(srcset)}\" ");
236:             sb.Append($"sizes=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(sizes)}\" ");
237:         }
238: 
239:         sb.Append("/>");
240:         return sb.ToString();
241:     }
242: 
243:     private static string? PickBestSrcFromSrcset(string? srcset, int targetWidth = 805)
244:     {
245:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
246:             return null;
247: 
248:         var matches = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(
249:             srcset,
250:             @"(?<url>\S+)(?:\s+(?<w>\d+)w)?"
251:         );
252: 
253:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int width)>();
254: 
255:         foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match match in matches)
256:         {
257:             if (!match.Groups["w"].Success)
258:                 continue;
259: 
260:             if (int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
261:             {
262:                 var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
263:                 candidates.Add((url, w));
264:             }
265:         }
266: 
267:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
268:             return null;
269: 
270:         return candidates
271:             .OrderBy(c => Math.Abs(c.width - targetWidth))
272:             .First()
273:             .url;
274:     }
275: 
276:     private static int GetPreferredMaxWidth(List<(string url, int? width)> candidates)
277:     {
278:         var widths = candidates
279:             .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
280:             .Select(c => c.width!.Value)
281:             .OrderBy(w => w)
282:             .ToList();
283: 
284:         if (widths.Count == 0)
285:             return 805;
286: 
287:         bool hasPng = candidates.Any(c =>
288:             c.url.Contains(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
289: 
290:         // Ideal preview range
291:         int target = hasPng ? 600 : 805;
292: 
293:         // Pick closest available width ABOVE target (not below → avoid blur)
294:         var best = widths.FirstOrDefault(w => w >= target);
295: 
296:         if (best != 0)
297:             return best;
298: 
299:         // fallback → largest available (if all smaller)
300:         return widths.Last();
301:     }
302: 
303:     private string? AssignDefaultThumbnailImg(string feedUrl)
304:     {
305:         return DefaultThumbnailTags.ThumbnailMap.FirstOrDefault(p => feedUrl.Contains(p.Key)).Value
306:             ?? LogAndReturnNull();
307: 
308:         string? LogAndReturnNull()
309:         {
310:             _logger.LogWarning("Error: No default thumbnail image tag assigned!");
311:             return null;
312:         }
313:     }
314: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Web/TagHelpers/ArticleImageTagHelper.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers;
 2: using HtmlAgilityPack;
 3: 
 4: [HtmlTargetElement("article-img")]
 5: public class ArticleImageTagHelper : TagHelper
 6: {
 7:     public string? ImageTag { get; set; }
 8: 
 9:     public int Index { get; set; }
10: 
11:     public override void Process(TagHelperContext context, TagHelperOutput output)
12:     {
13:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ImageTag))
14:         {
15:             output.SuppressOutput();
16:             return;
17:         }
18: 
19:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
20:         doc.LoadHtml(ImageTag);
21: 
22:         var img = doc.DocumentNode.SelectSingleNode("//img");
23:         if (img == null)
24:         {
25:             output.SuppressOutput();
26:             return;
27:         }
28: 
29:         // Only add loading strategy — do not touch sizes/srcset/style
30:         var loading = Index < 2 ? "eager" : "lazy";
31:         var decoding = Index < 2 ? "sync" : "async";
32: 
33:         img.SetAttributeValue("loading", loading);
34:         img.SetAttributeValue("decoding", decoding);
35: 
36:         output.TagName = null; // remove <article-img>
37:         output.Content.SetHtmlContent(img.OuterHtml);
38:     }
39: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemValidator.cs
================
 1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
 2: using System.Net;
 3: using System.Xml.Linq;
 4: 
 5: public class FeedItemValidator : IFeedItemValidator
 6: {
 7:     private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";
 8:     private static readonly XNamespace DcNs = "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/";
 9: 
10:     public bool IsValid(XElement itemElement) //TODO: Additional validation
11:     {
12:        var fields = new[] { "title", "link", "description", ContentNs + "encoded" };
13: 
14:         if (fields.Any(t => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(itemElement.Element(t)?.Value)))
15:             return false;
16: 
17:         if (itemElement.Element(DcNs + "creator")?.Value == "tinybuddha")
18:             return false;
19: 
20:         var html = itemElement.Element(ContentNs + "encoded")!.Value;
21: 
22:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
23:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
24: 
25:         if (doc.DocumentNode == null ||
26:             doc.DocumentNode.InnerHtml == null ||
27:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText) ||
28:             (doc.DocumentNode.InnerText.Length < 25))
29:         {
30:             return false;
31:         }
32: 
33:         return true;
34:     }
35: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Web/Controllers/HomeController.cs
================
  1: // File: PositiveNews.Web/Controllers/HomeController.cs
  2: 
  3: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
  4: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  5: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
  6: using PositiveNews.Web.Models;
  7: using System.Diagnostics;
  8: 
  9: namespace PositiveNews.Web.Controllers
 10: {
 11:     public class HomeController : Controller
 12:     {
 13:         private readonly AppDbContext _context;
 14:         private const int PageSize = 10;
 15: 
 16:         public HomeController(AppDbContext context)
 17:         {
 18:             _context = context;
 19:         }
 20: 
 21:         public async Task<IActionResult> Index(int page = 1, string? topic = null)
 22:         {
 23:             var query = _context.ArticlesMetadata
 24:                 .Include(a => a.Source)
 25:                 .Include(a => a.ArticleTopics)
 26:                     .ThenInclude(at => at.Topic)
 27:                 .Where(a => a.IsActive)
 28:                 .AsNoTracking();
 29: 
 30:             // Priority sorting (NOT filtering)
 31:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(topic))
 32:             {
 33:                 query = query
 34:                     .OrderByDescending(a => a.ArticleTopics
 35:                         .Any(at => at.Topic.Name == topic))
 36:                     .ThenByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt);
 37:             }
 38:             else
 39:             {
 40:                 query = query.OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt);
 41:             }
 42: 
 43:             var totalArticles = await query.CountAsync();
 44:             var totalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling(totalArticles / (double)PageSize);
 45: 
 46:             var articles = await query
 47:                 .Skip((page - 1) * PageSize)
 48:                 .Take(PageSize)
 49:                 .Select(a => new ArticlePreviewViewModel
 50:                 {
 51:                     Id = a.Id,
 52:                     SourceName = a.Source.Name,
 53:                     SourceLogoUrl = a.Source.LogoUrl,
 54:                     Title = a.Title,
 55:                     Author = a.Author,
 56:                     PublishedAt = a.PublishedAt,
 57:                     ImageTag = a.ImageTag,
 58:                     SummaryShort = a.SummaryShort ?? "No summary available.",
 59:                     Topics = a.ArticleTopics
 60:                         .Where(at => at.Topic != null)
 61:                         .Select(at => at.Topic.Name)
 62:                         .ToList()
 63:                 })
 64:                 .ToListAsync();
 65: 
 66:             var viewModel = new FeedIndexViewModel
 67:             {
 68:                 Articles = articles,
 69:                 CurrentPage = page,
 70:                 TotalPages = totalPages,
 71:                 SelectedTopic = topic
 72:             };
 73: 
 74:             return View(viewModel);
 75:         }
 76: 
 77:         // GET: /Home/ReadArticle/5
 78:         public async Task<IActionResult> ReadArticle(long id)
 79:         {
 80:             var article = await _context.ArticlesMetadata
 81:                 .Include(a => a.Source)
 82:                 .Include(a => a.Content)
 83:                 .AsNoTracking()
 84:                 .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == id && a.IsActive);
 85: 
 86:             if (article == null)
 87:             {
 88:                 return NotFound();
 89:             }
 90: 
 91:             var viewModel = new ArticleDetailViewModel
 92:             {
 93:                 Title = article.Title,
 94:                 SourceName = article.Source.Name,
 95:                 SourceLogoUrl = article.Source.LogoUrl,
 96:                 Author = article.Author,
 97:                 PublishedAt = article.PublishedAt,
 98:                 ContentHtml = article.Content?.ContentRaw
 99:             };
100: 
101:             return View(viewModel);
102:         }
103: 
104:         [ResponseCache(Duration = 0, Location = ResponseCacheLocation.None, NoStore = true)]
105:         public IActionResult Error()
106:         {
107:             return View(new ErrorViewModel { RequestId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? HttpContext.TraceIdentifier });
108:         }
109:     }
110: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemParser.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 3: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 5: using System.Xml.Linq;
 6: 
 7: public class FeedItemParser : IFeedItemParser
 8: {
 9:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
10:     
11:     private static readonly XNamespace DcNs = "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/";
12:     private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";
13: 
14:     public FeedItemParser(ILogger<FeedReader> logger, IImgTagExtractor imgTagextractor)
15:     {
16:         _logger = logger;
17:     }
18:     public RssFeedItemDto Parse(XElement itemElement)
19:     {
20:         return new RssFeedItemDto
21:         {
22:             Title = itemElement.Element("title")!.Value,              // "!" is because validator guarantees it exists.
23:             Link = itemElement.Element("link")!.Value,   
24:             Description = itemElement.Element("description")!.Value,
25:             ContentRaw = itemElement.Element(ContentNs + "encoded")!.Value,
26:             Author = itemElement.Element(DcNs + "creator")?.Value,    
27:             PublishedDate = ParseDate(itemElement),
28:             Topics = ExtractCategories(itemElement),
29:             ExternalId = itemElement.Element("guid")?.Value           //TODO: Add cleaner/cutter and regex conductor before parsing. Like in methods bellow
30:         };
31:     }
32: 
33:     
34:     private List<string> ExtractCategories(XElement itemElement)
35:     {
36:         var categories = itemElement
37:             .Elements("category")
38:             .Select(c => c.Value)
39:             .Where(v => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v))
40:             .Distinct()
41:             .ToList(); // Creates a NEW list each time
42: 
43:         if (categories.Count == 0)
44:         {
45:             categories = new List<string> { "Default" }; // NEW list, not shared
46:         }
47:         _logger.LogDebug("Extracted categories: {Categories}", string.Join(", ", categories));
48:         return categories;
49:     }
50: 
51:     private static DateTime ParseDate(XElement item)
52:     {
53:         var dateStr = item.Element("pubDate")?.Value?.Trim();
54: 
55:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dateStr))
56:         {
57:             // Common RSS date formats
58:             string[] formats = new[]
59:             {
60:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz",
61:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss K",
62:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss",
63:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz",
64:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssK",
65:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss"
66:             };
67: 
68:             if (DateTime.TryParseExact(dateStr, formats,
69:                 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
70:                 System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
71:             {
72:                 return result;
73:             }
74:             // Try standard parse as fallback
75:             if (DateTime.TryParse(dateStr, out result))
76:             {
77:                 return result;
78:             }
79:         }
80:         return DateTime.UtcNow;
81:     }
82: }
