 89:                         </div>
 90: 
 91:                         <!-- Summary -->
 92:                         <div id="summary-@article.Id"
 93:                              class="mt-3 p-3 bg-light rounded d-none">
 94:                             <strong>Summary:</strong>
 95:                             <p class="mb-0">@article.SummaryShort</p>
 96:                         </div>
 97:                     </div>
 98:                 </div>
 99:             }
100: 
101:             <!-- Pagination -->
102:             @if (Model.TotalPages > 1)
103:             {
104:                 <nav>
105:                     <ul class="pagination justify-content-center">
106: 
107:                         <li class="page-item @(Model.CurrentPage == 1 ? "disabled" : "")">
108:                             <a class="page-link"
109:                                    asp-action="Index"
110:                                    asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage - 1)"
111:                                    asp-route-topic="@Model.SelectedTopic">
112:                                 Previous
113:                             </a>
114:                         </li>
115: 
116:                         <li class="page-item disabled">
117:                             <span class="page-link">
118:                                 Page @Model.CurrentPage of @Model.TotalPages
119:                             </span>
120:                         </li>
121: 
122:                         <li class="page-item @(Model.CurrentPage == Model.TotalPages ? "disabled" : "")">
123:                             <a class="page-link"
124:                                    asp-action="Index"
125:                                    asp-route-page="@(Model.CurrentPage + 1)"
126:                                    asp-route-topic="@Model.SelectedTopic">
127:                                 Next
128:                             </a>
129:                         </li>
130: 
131:                     </ul>
132:                 </nav>
133:             }
134: 
135:         </div>
136:     </div>
137: </div>
138: 
139: @section Scripts {
140:     <script>
141:         function toggleSummary(id) {
142:             var el = document.getElementById(id);
143:             el.classList.toggle('d-none');
144:         }
145:     </script>
146: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedProcessor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using System.Xml.Linq;
  6: 
  7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
  8: 
  9: public class FeedProcessor : IFeedProcessor
 10: {
 11:     private readonly ILogger<FeedProcessor> _logger;
 12:     private readonly IFeedItemValidator _validator;
 13:     private readonly IFeedItemParser _parser;
 14:     private readonly IFeedItemCleaner _cleaner;
 15:     private readonly IImgTagExtractor _imgTagExtractor;
 16:     private readonly IPositivityAnalyzer _analyzer;
 17: 
 18:     public FeedProcessor(IFeedItemValidator validator,
 19:                          IFeedItemParser parser,
 20:                          IFeedItemCleaner cleaner,
 21:                          ILogger<FeedProcessor> loger,
 22:                          IImgTagExtractor imgTagExtractor,
 23:                          IPositivityAnalyzer analyzer)
 24:     {
 25:         _validator = validator;
 26:         _parser = parser;
 27:         _cleaner = cleaner;
 28:         _imgTagExtractor = imgTagExtractor;
 29:         _logger = loger;
 30:         _analyzer = analyzer;
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     public FeedProcessingResult ProcessFeed(string feedUrl, XDocument feed, TopicLookup lookup, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 34:     {
 35:         var dtoItems = new List<RssFeedItemDto>();
 36:         var invalidCount = 0;
 37: 
 38:         _logger.LogInformation("Processing RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
 39: 
 40:         var feedItems = feed.Descendants("item").ToList();
 41:         _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} items in RSS feed.", feedItems.Count);
 42: 
 43:         foreach (var feedItem in feedItems)
 44:         {
 45:             cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
 46: 
 47:             try
 48:             {
 49:                 if (!_validator.IsValid(feedItem))
 50:                 {
 51:                     _logger.LogWarning("Skipping invalid feed item.");
 52:                     invalidCount++;
 53:                     continue;
 54:                 }
 55: 
 56:                 var dtoItem = _parser.Parse(feedItem);
 57: 
 58:                 if (dtoItem.Topics == null)
 59:                     dtoItem.Topics = new List<string>();
 60: 
 61:                 _cleaner.Clean(dtoItem);
 62:                 _cleaner.CleanTopics(dtoItem, lookup);
 63:                 EnrichTopics(feedUrl, dtoItem, lookup);
 64: 
 65:                 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dtoItem.ContentRaw))
 66:                     continue;
 67: 
 68:                 dtoItem.ImageTag = _imgTagExtractor.ExtractImgTag(feedItem, dtoItem.ContentRaw, feedUrl);
 69: 
 70:                 if (!ContainsHeroImage(dtoItem.ContentRaw) &&
 71:                     !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dtoItem.ImageTag))
 72:                 {
 73:                     dtoItem.ContentRaw = string.Concat(dtoItem.ImageTag, dtoItem.ContentRaw);
 74:                 }
 75: 
 76:                 dtoItem.ContentClean = _cleaner.StripInnerHtmlWords(dtoItem.ContentRaw) ??
 77:                                        _cleaner.StripInnerHtmlWords(dtoItem.Description);
 78: 
 79:                 dtoItem.PositivityScore = _analyzer.AnalyzeSentiment(dtoItem.ContentClean);
 80: 
 81:                 dtoItems.Add(dtoItem);
 82:             }
 83:             catch (Exception ex)
 84:             {
 85:                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error parsing RSS feed item");
 86:                 invalidCount++;
 87:             }
 88: 
 89:             _logger.LogInformation("Feed item No.{Count} has been successfully processed.", dtoItems.Count);
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         return new FeedProcessingResult(dtoItems, invalidCount);
 93:     }
 94: 
 95:     private void EnrichTopics(string feedUrl, RssFeedItemDto dto, TopicLookup lookup)
 96:     {
 97:         dto.Topics ??= new List<string>();
 98: 
 99:         var result = new HashSet<string>(dto.Topics, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
100: 
101:         void Add(string name)
102:         {
103:             if (lookup.ByName.ContainsKey(name))
104:                 result.Add(name);
105:         }
106: 
107:         // Source-specific rules
108:         if (feedUrl.Contains("nvidia", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
109:             Add("Technology");
110: 
111:         if (feedUrl.Contains("nasa", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
112:         {
113:             Add("Space");
114:             Add("Technology");
115:             Add("Science");
116:         }
117: 
118:         if (feedUrl.Contains("thisiscolossal", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
119:             feedUrl.Contains("designyoutrust", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
120:         {
121:             Add("Arts & Culture");
122:         }
123: 
124:         if (feedUrl.Contains("tinybuddha", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
125:             Add("Psychology");
126: 
127:         // Parent topic expansion using reverse lookup
128:         var expandedTopics = new HashSet<string>(result, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
129: 
130:         foreach (var topicName in result.ToList())
131:         {
132:             if (!lookup.ByName.TryGetValue(topicName, out var topic))
133:                 continue;
134: 
135:             var slugWords = topic.Slug
136:                 .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
137:                 .Select(w => w.Trim());
138: 
139:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
140:             {
141:                 if (lookup.ByName.TryGetValue(word, out var related))
142:                 {
143:                     result.Add(related.Name);
144:                 }
145:             }
146:         }
147: 
148:         foreach (var expanded in expandedTopics)
149:             result.Add(expanded);
150: 
151:         if (result.Count == 0)
152:             Add("Default");
153: 
154:         dto.Topics = result.ToList();
155:     }
156: 
157:     private bool ContainsHeroImage(string html)
158:     {
159:         try
160:         {
161:             var doc = new HtmlDocument();
162:             doc.LoadHtml(html);
163: 
164:             var images = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes("//img");
165: 
166:             if (images == null || images.Count == 0)
167:                 return false;
168: 
169:             return images.Any(img =>
170:             {
171:                 var classAttr = img.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
172:                 return classAttr.Contains("img-fluid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
173:                        classAttr.Contains("w-100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
174:             });
175:         }
176:         catch (Exception ex)
177:         {
178:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error checking for fluid images in HTML content");
179:             return false;
180:         }
181:     }
182: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 6: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
 7: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
 8: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 9: 
10: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure;
11: 
12: /// <summary>
13: /// Clean Registration Pattern for the Infrastructure layer.
14: /// Call this single method from WebApi's Program.cs.
15: /// </summary>
16: public static class DependencyInjection
17: {
18:     public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructureServices(
19:         this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
20:     {
21:         // EF Core with SQL Server
22:         var connectionString = ConnectionStringResolver.Resolve(configuration);
23: 
24:         services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
25:                options.UseSqlServer(connectionString, sqlOptions =>
26:                       {
27:                           sqlOptions.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly.FullName);
28:                           sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3);
29:                       }));
30: 
31:         services.AddScoped<IIngestionDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>());
32: 
33:         // HttpClient for RSS feed fetching.
34:         // Configured with a polite User-Agent and a reasonable timeout.
35:         services.AddHttpClient("RssFeedClient", client =>
36:      {
37:          client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
38:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.ParseAdd(
39:             "PositiveNews/1.0 (+https://github.com/positivenews; Academic Project)");
40:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.ParseAdd("application/rss+xml, application/xml, text/xml");
41:      });
42: 
43:         // Application services
44:         services.AddScoped<IFeedReader, FeedReader>();
45:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemValidator, FeedItemValidator>();
46:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemParser, FeedItemParser>();
47:         services.AddScoped<IFeedProcessor, FeedProcessor>();
48:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemCleaner, FeedItemCleaner>();
49:         services.AddScoped<IImgTagExtractor, ImgTagExtractor>();
50:         services.AddScoped<IPositivityAnalyzer, KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer>();
51: 
52:         // Background services
53:         services.AddHostedService<IngestionBackgroundService>();
54: 
55:         return services;
56:     }
57: }

  1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

  8: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seeding;

 10: /// <summary>
 11: /// Applies migrations (creates DB if missing) and seeds reference data.
 12: /// Designed to be called once at application startup.
 13: /// </summary>
 14: public static class DataSeeder
 15: {
 16:     public static async Task SeedAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
 17:     {
 18:         using var scope = serviceProvider.CreateScope();
 19:         var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 20:         var logger = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<AppDbContext>>();
 21:         var configuration = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>();
 22: 
 23:         logger.LogInformation("Applying database migrations (will create DB if it does not exist)...");
 24:         await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
 25:         logger.LogInformation("Database migrations applied successfully.");
 26: 
 27:         await SeedRolesAsync(context, logger);
 28:         await SeedTopicsAsync(context, logger, configuration);
 29:         await SeedSourcesAsync(context, logger);
 30:         await SeedAdminUserAsync(context, logger);
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     private static async Task SeedRolesAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
 34:     {
 35:         if (await context.Roles.AnyAsync()) return;
 36: 
 37:         var roles = new List<Role>
 38:         {
 39:             new() { Name = "Admin" },
 40:             new() { Name = "Moderator" },
 41:             new() { Name = "User" }
 42:         };
 43: 
 44:         context.Roles.AddRange(roles);
 45:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 46:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} roles.", roles.Count);
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     private static async Task SeedTopicsAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger, IConfiguration? configuration = null)
 50:     {
 51:         if (await context.Topics.AnyAsync()) return;
 52: 
 53:         List<Topic> topics;
 54: 
 55:         // ALWAYS try to load from configuration if provided
 56:         if (configuration != null)
 57:         {
 58:             var topicConfig = configuration.GetSection("Topics").Get<TopicConfiguration>();
 59:             if (topicConfig?.Topics != null && topicConfig.Topics.Any())
 60:             {
 61:                 topics = topicConfig.Topics.Select(t => t.ToEntity()).ToList();
 62:                 logger.LogInformation("Loading topics from configuration.");
 63:             }
 64:             else
 65:             {
 66:                 logger.LogWarning("No topics found in configuration, using defaults.");
 67:                 topics = GetDefaultTopics(logger);
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:         else
 71:         {
 72:             logger.LogWarning("No configuration provided, using defaults.");
 73:             topics = GetDefaultTopics(logger);
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         context.Topics.AddRange(topics);
 77:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 78:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} topics.", topics.Count);
 79:     }
 80:

189:     private static async Task SeedAdminUserAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
190:     {
191:         if (await context.Users.AnyAsync()) return;
192: 
193:         // Seed a system/admin user to own future moderation actions.
194:         // In production, the password hash would come from a proper Identity hasher.
195:         var adminUser = new User
196:         {
197:             Email = "admin@positivenews.local",
198:             EmailConfirmed = true,
199:             Name = "System Administrator",
200:             PasswordHash = null, // Will be set via proper Auth flow later.
201:             IsActive = true
202:         };
203: 
204:         context.Users.Add(adminUser);
205:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
206: 
207:         var adminRole = await context.Roles.FirstAsync(r => r.Name == "Admin");
208:         context.UserRoles.Add(new UserRole { UserId = adminUser.Id, RoleId = adminRole.Id });
209:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
210: 
211:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded admin user '{Email}' with Admin role.", adminUser.Email);
212:     }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemCleaner.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  5: using System.Net;
  6: using System.Text;
  7: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
  8: 
  9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 10: 
 11: public class FeedItemCleaner : IFeedItemCleaner
 12: {
 13:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AllowedTags = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 14:     {
 15:         "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "p", "img", "video", "source", "ul", "ol", "li", "a", "iframe"
 16:     };
 17: 
 18:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AttributesToRemove = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 19:     {
 20:         "class", "style", "block_context"
 21:     };
 22: 
 23:     private static readonly string[] RemoveDivClassPatterns =
 24:     {
 25:         "navigation-menu",
 26:         "blocks-content-lists",
 27:         "hds-featured-file-list",
 28:         "hds-audio-player-",
 29:         "secondary-navigation",
 30:         "comparison-slider-parent",
 31:         "two-up-view",
 32:         "content-lists-inner",
 33:         "topic-cards",
 34:         "twitter-tweet",
 35:         "attachment-medium size-medium wp-post-image" //first image for Design You Trust
 36:     };
 37: 
 38:     // Patterns that trigger "stop processing all following content"
 39:     private static readonly string[] StopProcessingPatterns =
 40:     {
 41:         "About the Author",
 42:         //"For more information about",
 43:         "Discover More Topics From",
 44:         //"For more information on",
 45:         "Click here to leave a comment on the site",
 46:         "Members can also look for the following:",
 47:         "What are you planning to play this weekend?",
 48:         "in the comments below.",
 49:         "-end-"
 50:     };
 51: 
 52:     // Patterns that trigger removal of a single node
 53:     private static readonly string[] RemoveNodePatterns =
 54:     {
 55:     "Learn more about this image",
 56:     "Listen to this audio",
 57:     "follow us on",
 58:     "Donate link:",
 59:     "The Optimist Daily is a project of the World Business Academy",
 60:     "Subscribe to our",
 61:     "Want to be part of the Optimism Movement?",
 62:     "If you have questions, comments, feedback, suggestions, or just want to say hi, send a message to:"
 63:     };
 64: 
 65:     private static readonly Regex YoutubeRegex = new(
 66:     @"(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?(?:youtube\.com/watch\?v=|youtu\.be/|youtube\.com/embed/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})",
 67:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 68: 
 69:     private static readonly Regex StrongTildeRegex = new(
 70:     @"<strong>\s*(?<left>[^~<]+?)\s*~\s*[^<]*\s*</strong>",
 71:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 72: 
 73:     private static readonly Regex AppearedFirstOnRegex = new(
 74:     @"<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*appeared first on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 75:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 76: 
 77:     private static readonly Regex OptimistEditorialRegex = new(
 78:     @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY(?:’S|'S)? EDITORIAL TEAM",
 79:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 80: 
 81:     private static readonly Regex ThePostRegex = new(
 82:     @"The post\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*first appeared on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 83:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline);
 84: 
 85:     public void Clean(RssFeedItemDto dto)
 86:     {
 87:         dto.Description = CleanDescription(dto.Description);
 88:         dto.ContentRaw = CleanContent(dto.ContentRaw);  
 89:         dto.Title = CleanTitle(dto.Title);
 90:     }
 91: 
 92:     public string? StripInnerHtmlWords(string htmlContent)
 93:     {
 94:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(htmlContent))
 95:             return htmlContent; 
 96: 
 97:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
 98:         doc.LoadHtml(htmlContent);
 99:         var plainText = doc.DocumentNode.InnerText;
100: 
101:         return plainText;
102:     }
103: 
104:     private static string CleanContent(string rawContent)
105:     {
106:         var doc = LoadDocument(rawContent);
107:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
108:         var stopProcessing = false;
109: 
110:         ProcessNodesRecursively(doc.DocumentNode, builder, ref stopProcessing);
111: 
112:         var cleaned = RemoveTrailingPostLinks(builder.ToString());
113:         return RemoveTildeAuthor(cleaned).Trim();  
114:     }
115: 
116:     private static HtmlDocument LoadDocument(string html)
117:     {
118:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
119:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
120:         return doc;
121:     }
122: 
123:     private static void ProcessNodesRecursively(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
124:     {
125:         foreach (var child in node.ChildNodes)
126:         {
127:             if (stopProcessing)
128:                 return;
129: 
130:             if (child.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
131:                 continue;
132: 
133:             // Check for stop-processing triggers first
134:             if (ShouldStopProcessing(child))
135:             {
136:                 stopProcessing = true;
137:                 return;
138:             }
139: 
140:             // Check if node should be skipped entirely
141:             if (ShouldRemoveNode(child))
142:                 continue;
143: 
144:             var tagName = child.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
145: 
146:             // Handle special div transformations
147:             if (tagName == "div")
148:             {
149:                 ProcessDiv(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
150:                 continue;
151:             }
152: 
153:             // Handle anchor tags (check for YouTube links)
154:             if (tagName == "a")
155:             {
156:                 ProcessAnchor(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
157:                 continue;
158:             }
159: 
160:             // Handle lists with wp-block-list class
161:             if ((tagName == "ul" || tagName == "ol") && HasClassContaining(child, "wp-block-list"))
162:             {
163:                 ProcessList(child, builder);
164:                 continue;
165:             }
166: 
167:             if (AllowedTags.Contains(tagName))
168:             {
169:                 ProcessAllowedNode(child, tagName, builder, ref stopProcessing);
170:             }
171:             else
172:             {
173:                 // Recursively process children of non-allowed tags
174:                 ProcessNodesRecursively(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
175:             }
176:         }
177:     }
178: 
179:     private static void ProcessDiv(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
180:     {
181:         // Check if div should be removed by class
182:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
183:         {
184:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
185:                 return;
186:         }
187: 
188:         // Transform hds-caption-text divs to small italic paragraph
189:         if (HasClassContaining(node, "hds-caption-text"))
190:         {
191:             var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
192:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
193:             {
194:                 builder.AppendLine($"<p class=\"small fst-italic\">{System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(text)}</p>");
195:             }
196:             return;
197:         }
198: 
199:         // Otherwise, process children of the div
200:         ProcessNodesRecursively(node, builder, ref stopProcessing);
201:     }
202: 
203:     private static void ProcessAnchor(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
204:     {
205:         var href = node.GetAttributeValue("href", "");
206: 
207:         // Check if it's a YouTube link
208:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(href);
209:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
210:         {
211:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
212:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
213:             return;
214:         }
215: 
216:         // Check for YouTube links in the anchor's inner content (nested links)
217:         var innerHtml = node.InnerHtml;
218:         var innerMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(innerHtml);
219:         if (innerMatch.Success)
220:         {
221:             var videoId = innerMatch.Groups[1].Value;
222:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
223:             return;
224:         }
225: 
226:         // Otherwise, process anchor normally (keep it, process children)
227:         ProcessNodesRecursively(node, builder, ref stopProcessing);
228:     }
229: 
230:     private static string CreateYouTubeEmbed(string videoId)
231:     {
232:         return $@"<div class=""ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3"">
233:                 <iframe src=""https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId}"" 
234:                 title=""YouTube video"" 
235:                 allow=""accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"" 
236:                 allowfullscreen>
237:                 </iframe>
238:                 </div>";
239:     }
240: 
241:     private static void ProcessList(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
242:     {
243:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
244:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
245:     }
246: 
247:     private static void ProcessAllowedNode(HtmlNode node, string tagName, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
248:     {
249:         switch (tagName)
250:         {
251:             case "p":
252:                 ProcessParagraph(node, builder);
253:                 break;
254: 
255:             case "h1":
256:             case "h2":
257:             case "h3":
258:             case "h4":
259:                 ProcessHeader(node, builder);
260:                 break;
261: 
262:             case "img":
263:                 ProcessImage(node, builder);
264:                 break;
265: 
266:             case "video":
267:                 ProcessVideo(node, builder);
268:                 break;
269: 
270:             case "ul":
271:             case "ol":
272:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
273:                 break;
274: 
275:             case "li":
276:                 ProcessListItem(node, builder);
277:                 break;
278: 
279:             case "iframe":
280:                 ProcessIframe(node, builder);
281:                 break;
282:         }
283:     }
284: 
285:     private static void ProcessParagraph(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
286:     {
287:         // Check for YouTube iframes FIRST and extract them
288:         var iframes = node.SelectNodes(".//iframe");
289:         if (iframes != null)
290:         {
291:             foreach (var iframe in iframes)
292:             {
293:                 var src = iframe.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
294:                 var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
295:                 if (youtubeMatch.Success)
296:                 {
297:                     var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
298:                     builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302: 
303:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
304: 
305:         // Include iframe in media check
306:         var hasMedia = node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video | .//iframe") != null;
307:         var hasText = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text);
308: 
309:         // If paragraph ONLY contained iframe (already processed above), skip outputting empty <p>
310:         if (!hasText && iframes != null && node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video") == null)
311:             return;
312: 
313:         if (!hasText && !hasMedia)
314:             return;
315: 
316:         if (hasText && ShouldRemoveParagraph(text))
317:             return;
318: 
319:         var images = node.SelectNodes(".//img");
320:         if (images != null)
321:         {
322:             foreach (var img in images.ToList())
323:             {
324:                 var imgBuilder = new StringBuilder();
325:                 ProcessImage(img, imgBuilder);
326: 
327:                 // Replace original <img> with processed one
328:                 var newImgDoc = new HtmlDocument();
329:                 newImgDoc.LoadHtml(imgBuilder.ToString());
330:                 var newImg = newImgDoc.DocumentNode.FirstChild;
331:                 img.ParentNode.ReplaceChild(newImg, img);
332:             }
333:         }
334: 
335:         // THEN clean paragraph
336:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
337:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
338:     }
339: 
340:     private static void ProcessHeader(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
341:     {
342:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
343: 
344:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
345:             return;
346: 
347:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
348:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
349:     }
350: 
351:     private static void ProcessImage(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
352:     {
353:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
354: 
355:         if (classAttr.Contains("attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||
356:             classAttr.Contains("wp-biographia-avatar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
357:             classAttr.Contains("wp-smiley", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||  // ← Add this for emoji
358:             classAttr.Contains("emoji", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
359:         {
360:             // Remove unwanted attributes
361:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
362:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
363:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
364:                 .ToList();
365: 
366:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
367:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
368: 
369:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3");
370:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
371:         }
372:         else
373:         {
374:             // Remove unwanted attributes
375:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
376:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
377:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
378:                 .ToList();
379: 
380:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
381:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
382: 
383:             // Standard image styling
384:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3");
385:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
386:         }
387:     }
388: 
389:     private static void ProcessVideo(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
390:     {
391:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
392: 
393:         // Add Bootstrap responsive video classes
394:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100 rounded mb-3");
395:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("controls", "");
396: 
397:         var sources = cleanedNode.SelectNodes(".//source");
398:         if (sources != null)
399:         {
400:             foreach (var source in sources)
401:                 CleanAttributesRecursively(source);
402:         }
403: 
404:         // Wrap in responsive container
405:         var videoHtml = cleanedNode.OuterHtml;
406:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{videoHtml}</div>");
407:     }
408: 
409:     private static void ProcessIframe(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
410:     {
411:         var src = node.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
412: 
413:         // Check if it's a YouTube embed
414:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
415:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
416:         {
417:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
418:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
419:             return;
420:         }
421: 
422:         // Generic iframe - wrap in responsive container
423:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
424:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100");
425:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{cleanedNode.OuterHtml}</div>");
426:     }
427: 
428:     private static void ProcessListItem(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
429:     {
430:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
431:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
432:     }
433: 
434:     private static HtmlNode CleanAttributes(HtmlNode original)
435:     {
436:         var clone = original.CloneNode(true);
437:         CleanAttributesRecursively(clone);
438:         return clone;
439:     }
440: 
441:     private static void CleanAttributesRecursively(HtmlNode node)
442:     {
443:         if (node == null || node.Name.Equals("img", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
444:             return;
445: 
446:         if (node.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
447:         {
448: 
449:             // Remove script tags anywhere in the subtree
450:             var scripts = node.SelectNodes(".//script");
451:             if (scripts != null)
452:             {
453:                 foreach (var script in scripts.ToList())
454:                     script.Remove();
455:             }
456: 
457:             // Remove other non-allowed tags from cloned content
458:             var disallowedTags = node.SelectNodes(".//script | .//style | .//noscript");
459:             if (disallowedTags != null)
460:             {
461:                 foreach (var tag in disallowedTags.ToList())
462:                     tag.Remove();
463:             }
464: 
465:             // Remove unwanted attributes
466:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
467:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
468:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
469:                 .ToList();
470: 
471:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
472:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
473:         }
474: 
475:         foreach (var child in node.ChildNodes)
476:         {
477:             CleanAttributesRecursively(child);
478:         }
479:     }
480: 
481:     private static bool HasClassContaining(HtmlNode node, string pattern)
482:     {
483:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
484:         return classAttr.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
485:     }
486: 
487:     private static bool HasExactClass(HtmlNode node, string exactClass)
488:     {
489:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
490:         return classAttr.Equals(exactClass, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
491:     }
492: 
493:     private static bool ShouldStopProcessing(HtmlNode node)
494:     {
495:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
496: 
497:         // Check for single "Share" text
498:         if (text.Equals("Share", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
499:             return true;
500: 
501:         // Check for stop-processing patterns
502:         foreach (var pattern in StopProcessingPatterns)
503:         {
504:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
505:                 return true;
506:         }
507: 
508:         return false;
509:     }
510: 
511:     private static bool ShouldRemoveNode(HtmlNode node)
512:     {
513:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText);
514: 
515:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveNodePatterns)
516:         {
517:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
518:                 return true;
519:         }
520: 
521:         var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
522: 
523:        
524:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
525:         {
526:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
527:                 return true;
528:         }
529:         
530: 
531:         // Check for thumbnail images
532:         if (tagName == "img" && HasExactClass(node, "attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail"))
533:             return true;
534: 
535:         // ADD: Always remove script tags
536:         if (tagName == "script")
537:             return true;
538: 
539:         return false;
540:     }
541: 
542:     private static bool ShouldRemoveParagraph(string text)
543:     {
544:         var lower = text.ToLowerInvariant();
545:         return lower.Contains("did this solution stand out")
546:             || lower.Contains("becoming an emissary")
547:             || lower.StartsWith("the post ")
548:             || lower.Contains("appeared first on");
549:     }
550: 
551:     private static string RemoveTrailingPostLinks(string content)
552:     {
553:         return Regex.Replace(
554:             content,
555:             @"<\/p>\s*The post\s*<a.*?<\/a>.*",
556:             "",
557:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);
558:     }
559: 
560:     private static string CleanDescription(string description)
561:     {
562:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
563:             return string.Empty;
564: 
565:         // Decode HTML entities first
566:         var html = WebUtility.HtmlDecode(description);
567: 
568:         html = ThePostRegex.Replace(html, "");
569: 
570:         // -------------------------------------------------------
571:         // 1. Remove "~something" inside <strong>
572:         // -------------------------------------------------------
573:         html = StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
574: 
575:         // -------------------------------------------------------
576:         // 2. Remove unwanted editorial paragraph
577:         // -------------------------------------------------------
578:         html = OptimistEditorialRegex.Replace(html, "");
579: 
580:         // -------------------------------------------------------
581:         // 3. Remove "appeared first on Colossal"
582:         // -------------------------------------------------------
583:         html = AppearedFirstOnRegex.Replace(html, "");
584: 
585:         // -------------------------------------------------------
586:         // 4. Parse HTML safely
587:         // -------------------------------------------------------
588:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
589:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
590: 
591:         var paragraphs = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes("//p");
592: 
593:         if (paragraphs == null || paragraphs.Count == 0)
594:             return TrimAfterLastDot(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText);
595: 
596:         var texts = paragraphs
597:     .Select(p => HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(p.InnerText).Trim())
598:     .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
599:     .Where(t =>
600:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"appeared first on", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) &&
601:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) &&
602:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"^The post ", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)
603:     );
604: 
605:         var result = string.Join(" ", texts);
606: 
607:         // Final safety cleanup (text-level)
608:         result = Regex.Replace(
609:             result,
610:             @"The post .*? first appeared on .*?\.",
611:             "",
612:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);
613: 
614:         result = Regex.Replace(
615:             result,
616:             @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY.*?(?=\.)",
617:             "",
618:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
619: 
620:         result = result.Length > 1999 ? result[..1999] : result;
621: 
622:         // -------------------------------------------------------
623:         // 5. Trim everything after last dot
624:         // -------------------------------------------------------
625:         return TrimAfterLastDot(result);
626:     }
627: 
628:     private static string TrimAfterLastDot(string text)
629:     {
630:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
631:             return text;
632: 
633:         var lastDotIndex = text.LastIndexOf('.');
634: 
635:         if (lastDotIndex > 0)
636:             return text.Substring(0, lastDotIndex + 1).Trim();
637: 
638:         return text.Trim();
639:     }
640: 
641:     private static string CleanTitle(string title)
642:     {
643:         return title.Length > 500 ? title[..500] : title;
644:     }
645: 
646:     private static string RemoveTildeAuthor(string html)
647:     {
648:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
649:             return html;
650: 
651:         return Regex.Replace(
652:             html,
653:             @"<strong>\s*(?<left>[^~<]+?)\s*~\s*[^<]*\s*</strong>",
654:             "<strong>${left}</strong>",
655:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled
656:         );
657:     }
658: 
659:     public void CleanTopics(RssFeedItemDto dto, TopicLookup lookup)
660:     {
661:         if (dto.Topics == null || dto.Topics.Count == 0)
662:         {
663:             dto.Topics = new List<string>(); // Replace with empty list
664:             return;
665:         }
666: 
667:         var result = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
668: 
669:         foreach (var raw in dto.Topics)
670:         {
671:             // Only split and match individual words, don't add the original raw string
672:             var words = raw
673:                 .Split(new[] { ' ', ',', ';', '&', '/', '|', '-' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
674:                 .Select(w => w.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
675:                 .Where(w => w.Length > 2); // Ignore short words like "new", "the", "and"
676: 
677:             foreach (var word in words)
678:             {
679:                 if (lookup.BySlugWord.TryGetValue(word, out var matchedTopics))
680:                 {
681:                     foreach (var topic in matchedTopics)
682:                     {
683:                         // Only add if the word meaningfully matches
684:                         if (IsMeaningfulMatch(word, topic))
685:                         {
686:                             result.Add(topic.Name);
687:                         }
688:                     }
689:                 }
690:             }
691:         }
692: 
693:         // REPLACE the original list, don't add to it
694:         dto.Topics = result.ToList();
695:     }
696: 
697:     private bool IsMeaningfulMatch(string word, Topic topic)
698:     {
699:         // Don't match common short words
700:         var commonWords = new[] { "new", "old", "big", "small", "good", "bad", "hot", "cold" };
701:         if (commonWords.Contains(word))
702:             return false;
703: 
704:         // Don't match if the word is just a number
705:         if (int.TryParse(word, out _))
706:             return false;
707: 
708:         return true;
709:     }
710: }
